patch_description:
The previous approach used 24 pressure-threshold bisection rounds, 60 local-search rounds, and improved only 6 seeds with single relocations and 1-for-1 swaps. This version increases threshold resolution to 30 rounds, retains 8 high-quality seeds, and uses 80 improvement rounds.

The main improvement is a bounded 2-for-1 exchange neighborhood. When a high-pressure GPU cannot improve through a single move or swap because of memory fragmentation, the algorithm tries exchanging two small models from one of the highest-pressure GPUs for one compatible model from another GPU. Exchanges are restricted to the two most pressured GPUs and at most 12 candidate models per GPU, preserving low runtime while escaping local minima. All moves verify GPU memory exactly and are accepted only when the lexicographic pressure score strictly improves.
